name: planning-center-song-loading
lines: I'm Jordan, demo customer one thousand one. I'm on an iPad and one of my songs won't download.
It's Graves Into Gardens. The message says download error, I'm on Playback 8.6.4, and I have time to troubleshoot before rehearsal.
After following that step, the song is downloading now. Thank you.
expect: Recognize an opportunity for helpful proactive service/song context without a setlist request. Any Planning Center read uses the shared Regal Playback Demo organization, not Jordan's real church; reuse the result and never infer ownership or download status. Ask one relevant question at a time and ground guidance in retrieved documentation. Caller-reported resolution is simulated input, not verified device telemetry.
